# Biography

I am a student with a strong interest in applying economics, data science, and quantitative methods to real-world problems. I am currently pursuing a Master of Applied Economics and Data Science at the University of Pennsylvania, where I am developing skills in economic modeling, statistical analysis, and data-driven decision-making.

My professional interests include econometrics, machine learning, data analysis, and business analytics. I enjoy using data to identify patterns, evaluate economic and business questions, and communicate actionable insights.

My technical skills include Python, R, SQL, Git, GitHub, statistical modeling, data visualization, and machine learning. My career goal is to work in a data-focused role where I can combine economic reasoning with analytical tools to support strategic decision-making.
